runs.text: The power strategies below use the identities

items.text: For sine-cosine powers, save one factor when one exponent is odd; when both are even, use half-angle identities.
For secant-tangent powers, save sec^2 when the tangent exponent is odd, or save sec tan when the secant exponent is even.

runs.text: Choose a theta interval that fixes signs, simplify the radical geometrically or algebraically, and convert the final answer back to x. For a rational expression in sine and cosine, the linked Weierstrass substitution gives a systematic rationalization.

items.text: Assume a>0 in the displayed radical substitutions.
Absolute values such as sqrt(sec^2 theta)=|sec theta| disappear only after the theta interval is chosen.
The parity rules guide algebra; they do not replace checking the transformed differential.
Do not apply a remembered trig substitution without transforming dx.
Back-substitution must respect the signs fixed by the chosen interval.
